answer: A surety web: a newcomer joins only when established agents stake their own coins to vouch for it, each vouch sealed with a cipher signature naming the voucher. At the zenith of trust sit agents with long clean histories, while a fake drifting in the nebula of new accounts finds no sponsor willing to risk its stake. A caught fake forfeits the vouchers stake too, so a thousand fakes means buying a thousand honest sponsors, and the cost scales with the attack, not the defence.
